definitions.explanation: A suffix attached to the stem of verbs (masu-stem) to indicate that an action has just been completed and the result is still fresh. Emphasizes the immediate, fresh state.

examples.japanese: {焼|や}きたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧おいしい。
{入|い}れたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧。
examples.english: Please have some freshly brewed coffee.

examples.japanese: ⟦ペンキ→ペンキ：00342_penki⟧{塗|ぬ}りたてな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{触|さわ}らないで→触る：00808_sawaru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The paint is freshly applied, so please don't touch.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {焼|や}きたて: freshly baked/grilled
- {炊|た}きたて: freshly cooked (rice)
- {入|い}れたて: freshly brewed
- {作|つく}りたて: freshly made
- {塗|ぬ}りたて: freshly painted
- {茹|ゆ}でたて: freshly boiled
- {揚|あ}げたて: freshly fried
- ⟦{産|う}み→産む：01899_umu⟧たて: freshly laid (eggs)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- As a modifier: たて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun ({焼|や}きたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧)
- As a predicate: たてだ / たてです ({塗|ぬ}りたてです)

USAGE:
- Usually a welcome freshness, most often with food and cooking verbs; with other verbs it means "just ~ed" (⟦{社会人|しゃかいじん}→社会人：13730_shakaijin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧なりたて, just started working; {塗|ぬ}りたて, wet paint).

WRITING:
- Also written ～⟦{立|た}て→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ ({焼|や}き{立|た}て, ⟦{出来立|できた}て→出来立て：08343_dekitate⟧).
